title: Quick Springy Jamaican Chicken Curry
description: A savory and springy Jamaican dish featuring almond milk and wok-hei, perfect for meal prep, made in a hot pot vessel and friendly to those with nut allergies by using sunflower seeds as a substitute.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in the hot pot vessel over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and saute until it starts to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the chicken to the hot pot vessel and cook until it is browned on all sides and cooked through.
Add the curry powder, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in the almond milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the curry simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed, adding the scotch bonnet pepper if desired for extra heat.
Stir in the sunflower seeds and let the curry simmer for another 2 minutes.
Serve the Quick Springy Jamaican Chicken Curry hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
